sectionDescription: These are the blind spots I see in almost every Director and VP candidate. Let's fix yours before the bar raiser finds them.

before.title: Senior Manager
before.subtitle: Stuck at L5 for 3 years
before.details: Strong technical skills but struggled to articulate leadership impact in behavioral interviews

coaching.approach: Restructured 12 leadership stories with quantified outcomes and senior-level framing

after.title: L6 at Amazon
after.details: Passed all 5 interview loops including bar raiser

before.title: Principal Engineer
before.subtitle: Failed 2 Director loops
before.details: Technical depth was strong but missing strategic thinking and cross-functional leadership examples

coaching.approach: Built end-to-end portfolio of strategic initiatives with measurable business outcomes

after.title: Director at Meta
after.details: Received competing offers from 2 FAANG companies

before.title: TPM at Startup
before.subtitle: No FAANG experience
before.details: Excellent program management skills but resume didn't showcase scale or complexity

coaching.approach: Reframed startup experience to highlight FAANG-relevant scope and cross-team impact

before.title: Solutions Architect
before.subtitle: Rejected at Principal level
before.details: Deep AWS expertise but couldn't demonstrate thought leadership and customer obsession at scale

coaching.approach: Developed compelling narratives around customer success and technical innovation

caseStudyShowcase.title: Client Transformations
caseStudyShowcase.description: Every case study represents a real coaching engagement. Names and companies anonymized for privacy.
caseStudyShowcase.privacyNote: All coaching sessions are 100% confidential. These outcomes are shared with client permission.

services.title: 5-Week Cohort Program
services.description: Join a small group of senior engineers for intensive prep. Live sessions, peer learning, and structured accountability to land your dream role.

services.title: System Design Gaps
services.description: Most senior candidates can design systems. But can you explain WHY you made each decision? That's where bar raisers catch you.

services.title: Weak Leadership Stories
services.description: Your stories sound like project updates, not leadership impact. Bar raisers want conflict, stakes, and measurable outcomes.

services.title: Missing Executive Presence
services.description: You're being evaluated as a future leader, not just a contributor. Can you command a room? Compress complexity? Lead up?

services.title: Forgettable First Impression
services.description: Your opening 2 minutes set the tone. Most candidates waste them with a resume recap. You need a hook that opens doors.

services.title: Tasks Instead of Impact
services.description: Your resume lists what you did, not what you achieved. Senior screens look for quantified business outcomes.

services.title: Comp Negotiation Strategy
services.description: You've earned the offer. Now maximize it. Most candidates leave $50-150K on the table because they don't know how to leverage competing offers.

services.title: Full Gap Coverage
services.description: 5 sessions to systematically close every gap. We cover it all: stories, system design, presence, negotiation, and positioning.
